requirements.evidence: Config key `'mention_id' => env('DISCORD_MENTION_ID')` (config/services.php:40); validation `preg_match('/\A[0-9]{17,20}\z/', $candidate)` after `trim` with int accepted (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:71-85); mention `"\n<@{$id}>"` on its own line (line 64); truncation reserves room `self::MaxContentLength - mb_strlen($mention)` (line 44-46); no-mention path unchanged `mb_substr($body, 0, self::MaxContentLength)` (line 41). `\z` correctly rejects trailing-newline payloads; signature of send() untouched. .env.example, devops.md and logging.md updated.

conventions.evidence: Change stays in the existing App\Ops class with private helpers, no new layers; docs synced (docs/ops/devops.md:61,70,74, docs/ops/logging.md:83) and CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased] (CHANGELOG.md:24); PHPDoc on new helper (DiscordOpsAlert.php:49-55); tests added in the existing Pest file.

security.evidence: Strict anchored allowlist `\A[0-9]{17,20}\z` blocks `@everyone`, `@here`, `"123\n@everyone"`, `"123> \n@everyone"`; non-string/non-int config values return null (DiscordOpsAlert.php:75-77). Existing redaction and soft-fail logging paths untouched.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:147-229 cover valid mention on own line, null/''/whitespace (no `<@`), all invalid values from the task plus 16/21-digit boundaries, trimming and integer input, and truncation keeping mention at exactly 1800 chars. Existing tests not modified.

simplicity.evidence: Implementation is minimal (one regex, two small helpers). mentionSuffix() is a thin wrapper over mentionId(); tests repeat the same 5-line webhook setup in each test rather than a beforeEach.

readability.evidence: Clear names (`mentionSuffix`, `mentionId`, `$room`) and docblock. New tests are appended at top level after the closing `});` of an existing block (DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:145-147) rather than grouped with sibling tests.

scope.evidence: Diff touches only .env.example, config/services.php, DiscordOpsAlert.php, the two required ops docs, CHANGELOG and the test file; no unrelated edits.

issues.explanation: New tests sit outside the existing describe/group block that the file's sibling tests use, and repeat identical webhook/Http::fake setup that could be shared.
mentionSuffix() only wraps mentionId(); the two helpers could be one method without loss of clarity.

review.summary: Adds an optional DISCORD_MENTION_ID config that appends a strictly validated `<@snowflake>` mention on its own line, reserving room for it within the 1800-character cap, with docs, changelog and thorough Pest tests covering valid, invalid, trimmed, integer and truncation cases. All requirements and the contract are met with lean, safe code; only cosmetic nits remain, so it is approvable as is.
